title: Chroma
description: A colour-specialist studio after dark: aubergine black, a magenta-to-tangerine gradient, wide Syne headings.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: Colour that does not ask permission
tokens.HERO_LEDE: Vivids, pastels, colour-melts and corrections, from a studio that does nothing else.
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: No cuts, no extensions, no bridal. Since 2020 the studio has done one thing: bright colour that stays bright, on hair that stays healthy.
tokens.QUOTE: If it fades in two weeks, it was not done properly.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A colour-only studio for vivids, pastels and corrections.
tokens.S1_TEXT: Saturated colour from root to tip, in one shade or several.
tokens.S2_TEXT: Soft washes of colour on pre-lightened hair. Fades clean.
tokens.S3_TEXT: Banding, box dye and colour that went wrong elsewhere. We fix it.
